name: RClone Manager
short_desc: Manage the host rclone service, transfers and mounts
author: Zarestia-Dev
description: RClone Manager provides a web interface for the existing host rclone service, with remote configuration, file management, transfers, scheduling and host mounts. The host backend is selected automatically on first startup.

form_fields.label: Web UI username
form_fields.hint: Choose a username for signing in to RClone Manager.

form_fields.label: Web UI password
form_fields.hint: Choose a password for signing in to RClone Manager.

form_fields.label: Host rclone RC username
form_fields.hint: The existing RCLONE_RC_USER from the host rclone service's rc.env file.

form_fields.label: Host rclone RC password
form_fields.hint: The existing RCLONE_RC_PASS from the host rclone service's rc.env file. Update this field if the host password changes.

form_fields.label: Credential encryption secret
form_fields.hint: Generated once for Manager's saved credentials. Back up this secret with app data; changing it can make saved credentials unreadable.
